items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Howard was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 9, 2003 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Howard was interviewed in Toronto, Canada on January 9, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Toronto filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at the IAJE convention. I’m very pleased to have journalist Howard Mandel here.
